querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_compcode,
                                      report_period,
                                      ann_dt,
                                      vat,
                                      business_tax,
                                      corporate_income_tax,
                                      urban_maintenance_tax,
                                      property_tax,
                                      personal_income_tax,
                                      sale_tax,
                                      land_holding_tax,
                                      stamp_duty,
                                      vehicle_usage_tax,
                                      land_value_added_tax,
                                      resource_tax,
                                      other,
                                      total,
                                      memo,
                                      statement_type,
                                      education_surcharge,
                                      flood_control_fund,
                                      compensation_mineral_resources,
                                      vehicle_purchase_surcharge,
                                      agriculture_forestry_tax,
                                      local_education_fee,
                                      price_control_fund,
                                      statement_type_code,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_cbondtaxespayable.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.cbondtaxespayable WHERE report_period BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
